text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'll burn the sight of Eishin Flash
running into my memory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was the quiet thought on my mind as our
final summer training camp began, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
That's fine and all, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
you are looking at me, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Of course. I'm your Trainer, after all.
Of course. I'm your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I mean.
There is clearly something behind that gaze.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If there is anything on your mind,
please put it into words and tell me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I had been completely seen through.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—You burned the sight of my run into your memory?
Why...?
choice_data_list: Because I love watching you run.
Because I love watching you run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The initial spark that made me want to become her Trainer—
it was the sight of her running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that seeing her run made me want to support her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even when compared to the way others run,
I don't believe my running style has any particularly unique traits.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You don't know the reason, you say?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So you have run all this way following something with no basis at all, have you?
choice_data_list: Still, that intuition was spot on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running with her up to this point made me realize something.
Becoming her Trainer that day was truly the "right thing" for me to do.
choice_data_list: You shone brightly at both the Osaka Hai and Tenno Sho (Spring).
You shone brightly at both the Osaka Hai and Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot say whether that was the case.
However, I do take pride in the run I delivered."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If it had been just me, I might have fallen apart long ago.
It is thanks to you... that I have been able to
fulfill this schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: The two of us made sure it was done right.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...From the way you're talking, isn't it a bit early to look back?
It almost sounds as if everything is coming to an end—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Setting a schedule
means defining the end.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was decided from the very start.
So then, why—
